meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

howto.what: Claude 会按步骤把指定的 NanoClaw 智能体组切换到本地 Ollama 模型：检查代码、修改容器环境和模型设置、重建并重启服务，最后验证是否生效。也能改回 Anthropic API。
howto.when: 当用户想把 NanoClaw 智能体组改用本地 Ollama 模型、节省 API 费用，或尝试开源权重模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个智能体组改用本地 Ollama，并屏蔽 Anthropic API。
say.note: Claude 会加入屏蔽配置以防意外费用。

say.text: 把这个智能体组改回 Anthropic API。
say.note: Claude 会移除本地配置并重启服务。

howto.what_en: Claude will configure a NanoClaw agent group to use a local Ollama model: check code, update container config and model settings, rebuild and restart, then verify. It can also revert the group back to the Anthropic API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models.

say_en.text: Switch my NanoClaw agent group to the local Ollama model gemma4.
say_en.note: Claude will start by checking code and editing configs.

say_en.text: Use local Ollama for this agent group and block the Anthropic API.
say_en.note: Claude will add the block to prevent accidental spend.

say_en.text: Revert this agent group back to the Anthropic API.
say_en.note: Claude will remove the overrides and restart.
